name: Barabazar–Balarampur District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 165, Barabazar–Balarampur District road, crosses the border between West Bengal and Jharkhand. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — West Bengal PWD and Jharkhand RCD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
